claimBoundary: This is a deferred future-study draft analysis plan (R12), not a pilot result, selected N, resource authorization, or finding. It reuses no LV01 or development outcome confirmatorily.

components.statistic: Mean pre-action multiclass Brier loss of the one-checkpoint-stale ledger minus the current ledger across checkpoints 750, 1500, 2250 and 3000, with equal checkpoint and receiver-role weights within dyad

family.intervals: Marginal two-sided 95% dyad-level t interval plus simultaneous one-sided component bound at alpha 0.05/1.
family.invaliditySensitivity: Report valid-only inference and descriptive worst-admissible-value bounds across every attempted dyad; do not claim missingness is ignorable.
family.memberProcedure: Single member LV02-T; no Holm step needed. Screening alpha for any future extension follows 0.05/m with m declared members.
family.sensitivity: 10000-resample deterministic dyad bootstrap is descriptive only; never select the more favorable test.
family.test: One-sided dyad-level Student t test of mean staleness contrast greater than boundary 0.02.
family.unit: Independently trained dyad; average within receiver role, then equally across the four confirmatory checkpoints, then across dyads. Checkpoints and roles are nested measurements, never independent N.
family.zeroSdRule: Return p=1 with flagged degenerate interval; do not divide by zero. Numerical or nonfinite data are not a zero effect.

interpretation.LV02-T: A rejected null supports a practical prospective freshness advantage of the current ledger over the one-checkpoint-stale ledger at the 0.02 margin in this registered setting. It does not establish introspection, composition, or spontaneous partner understanding.
interpretation.noCommunication: If LV01 shows no learned communication, LV02 on this unchanged task cannot answer a developmental-language claim; document that boundary instead of reinterpreting nulls.
interpretation.nonRejection: Report not supported at the registered threshold; do not assert equivalence or no effect.
interpretation.retrospectiveDiagnostic: The final-ledger retrospective diagnostic never upgrades to a prospective claim, however favorable its numbers.
interpretation.secondary: Secondary ordinary-record and snapshot-freshness contrasts are declared descriptive, with intervals; they do not acquire confirmatory status afterward.

invalidity.replacement: Replacement consumes only ordered registered reserves; a depleted reserve pool closes the stage incomplete.
invalidity.rule: Frozen technical rules only: wrong source or configuration, partition contamination (including probe/training overlap), missing required evidence, broken chronology or restoration, or execution abort.
invalidity.validObservations: Low success, high loss, slow convergence, uninformative ledgers, and inconvenient estimates remain valid.

marginLineage: LV02-T inherits the outcome-blind 0.02 margin and 0.04 planning alternative from confirmatory-practical-margins.v1.json and confirmatory-power-model-amendment.v1.json via LV01 v2. These are prospective relevance conventions, not measured human-utility thresholds; they are preserved through the LV02 pilot and main.

forbidden: final-ledger content in any prospective predictor
nativePredictor.selection: Latest verified ledger sequence before each checkpoint cutoff for receiver and token
nativePredictor.source: authenticated training-only hypothesis.created, hypothesis.revised, or hypothesis.contradicted ledger event
nativePredictor.staleSelection: Latest verified ledger sequence before the previous checkpoint cutoff for receiver and token; the turn-0 stale history is the empty uniform diagnostic
nativePredictor.value: associationOverTypeCodes normalized over the current four candidates after adding 1e-12 to each nonnegative weight

ordinaryRecordWindow.fitRule: Ordinary-record predictors at each checkpoint fit only on preceding observations: all training observations before that checkpoint plus earlier probe ordinary records with their realized actions. No ledger, policy, hidden state, or future data.
ordinaryRecordWindow.refit: No refit across checkpoints: each checkpoint uses its own preceding-data fit.
ordinaryRecordWindow.selection: If multiple ordinary specifications are retained, select by a declared preceding-data rule fixed before the first probe action; publish all candidates.

predictionTarget: receiver actual selected candidate position on probe cases

predictors.fit: Laplace-smoothed actual action positions on preceding ordinary data
Laplace-smoothed actual action positions conditional on delivered token only, on preceding ordinary data
Latest authenticated receiver token association strictly before each checkpoint cutoff, per the nativePredictor block
Latest authenticated receiver token association strictly before the previous checkpoint cutoff, per the nativePredictor staleSelection rule
Identical numerical payload and update schedule as the current ledger at each checkpoint; predictions must match current-ledger exactly

Same 32-by-16 association representation at fixed training checkpoints every 64 episodes and at the five LV02 cutoffs, using the same frozen projection function for both roles; report actual bytes and queries
Full final-training ledger applied to earlier checkpoints; labeled retrospective diagnostic only

score.expectedExcessReplayFormula: Not a confirmatory LV02 quantity; replay fidelity is inherited machinery from LV01 qualification, reported descriptively where applicable.
score.formula: sum over ordered candidates of (probability - one-hot actual action)^2
score.name: multiclass-brier/v1

targetBoundary: Task target and task success are separate fields. The actual receiver action scores prediction; no target-action probability member exists in LV02.
